Builds are focused on early game for playing 1-55 without respec. If you used respec the builds would not only be stronger but entirely different. The early levels are designed for various bosses. So 15 the build needs to fight Aurora. By 18-21 the Forgefiend. by 30 the Fabricator Delphim, by 40 yremeryss and by 50 Uralon & Daybreak
